macro.fed_impact: The FOMC held the fed funds target range at 3.75%-4.00% on 2026-10-28 by a 10-2 vote. Governor Cook and Cleveland Fed President Hammack dissented in favor of a hike. The statement kept 'inflation remains elevated', and one report says it upgraded its growth assessment to 'strong'. The policy bias is hawkish rather than easing. That raises the discount rate applied to long-duration, high-multiple AI-semiconductor equity such as AVGO. Broadcom also carries sizeable debt (not verified in this run), so higher-for-longer rates matter for its financing costs. No file or search supplied a dated AVGO-specific rate sensitivity, so the directional effect is inferred rather than observed.
